estimation_method.formula: output_tokens = artifact_bytes / 3.8; input_tokens = output_tokens * 4.2 + (dispatches - 1) * 12000; total_tokens = input_tokens + output_tokens
estimation_method.artifact_bytes_source: wc -c on this run's own handoffs/*.yaml, plan/*, design/*, test/auditron/*, deploy/*.md, plus the actual authored repo files under ui.content/.../conf/headless-test (CF models, fragments, persisted queries, excluding binary DAM renditions) and ui.config (CORS/endpoint config) for composer/configsmith respectively.
estimation_method.caveat: This measures OUTPUT ARTIFACT volume, not actual session token consumption (which also includes every file read, every tool call round-trip, and internal reasoning - none of which is logged anywhere in this run). The input:output ratio and rework-overhead constant are reasoned assumptions typical of agentic coding sessions, not derived from this run's own telemetry, because none exists.
